fact: INE's 2024 Inquérito Multiobjetivo Contínuo, as reported in June 2025, put internet use among people aged 10 or over at 77% in urban areas and 64% in rural areas, and household internet access at 71.8% urban and 58.9% rural.
title: Quase 70% das famílias em Cabo-Verde com acesso à Internet em 2024, diz INE
